conditions: The data definition is a CDS view declared with DEFINE VIEW in the scoped release and is activated.
limitations: The claim covers the documented DDIC-based view form. DEFINE VIEW ENTITY, abstract CDS entities, access-control definitions and downstream database behavior have distinct evidentiary scopes.

triggers: Vendor correction, version remapping, source byte drift, or contrary primary evidence.

statement: SAP documents separate CDS entity and CDS database view objects in the ABAP Dictionary when a CDS data definition made with DEFINE VIEW is activated in AS ABAP 7.54.
